name: cf-cdn-dns-parser
description: Parses Cloudflare DNS backup file (DNS.txt) to identify proxied (orange-cloud) domains that require CloudFront distributions. Detects Cloudflare for SaaS configurations and aborts if found. Groups subdomains by apex domain for ACM certificate planning, identifies wildcard and multi-level subdomains, and produces dns_manifest.yaml (structured domain list with metadata) and user_input_template.csv (per-domain spreadsheet for the operator to fill in default cache behavior and ACM certificate ARN).
